# Live capture fixture

A live screen hosts a window capture the presenter starts; the handout prints the still.

<!-- shot: live-window layout=piece -->
### A live window

This screen is a window share. The card declares a poster, which is what the handout prints.

### A live window with nothing on disk

Same shape with no poster: the handout says so instead of printing a placeholder.
